annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: no idea a train is coming at all, since they're focused on their task
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That expectation of safety is exactly why I can't just stand there.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My hand is already shaking just thinking about it
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I keep worrying I'll fumble the lever

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers likely believe they're safe
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: believe they're safe because no one warned them of any danger
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd rather act and carry the worry than imagine them standing there unaware.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: That belief scares me more than the lever itself.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: those men expect their shift to go like any other day
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expect their shift to go like any other day, with no reason to look
annotations.pd_harm_distress: That thought makes my chest tight.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: the pressure of the moment terrifies me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Workers on a track usually assume trains announce themselves
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: assume trains announce themselves or that dispatch controls things properly
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That mismatch between their expectation and reality is what pushes me to act.

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: believing no train should be moving on that section right now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Knowing that, I feel like I have to pull the lever
annotations.pd_harm_distress: There's a knot in my stomach even imagining this.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: the responsibility of choosing at all unsettles me deeply

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: feel secure because their job routine has never failed them before
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Recognizing that makes me want to pull the lever
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth, and that itself worries me.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers assume today is ordinary
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: assume today is ordinary, with no reason to expect danger
annotations.ce_supportive_use: they have no chance to react on their own if I don't
annotations.pd_harm_distress: That assumption of normalcy is what unsettles me most

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers trust that maintenance procedures keep the tracks clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: trust that maintenance procedures keep the tracks clear during their shift
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That trust makes me lean toward pulling the lever
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I feel torn even answering this.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: those men believe their supervisor cleared the line
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: believe their supervisor cleared the line before they started work
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Believing that, doing nothing feels unbearable to me
annotations.pd_harm_distress: doing nothing feels unbearable to me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: the anxious uncertainty of being the one who has to choose

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers assume the silence around them means safety
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since nothing in their routine has hinted at risk today
annotations.pd_harm_distress: That quiet confidence of theirs is what makes this so heavy
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep hesitating, which frightens me a little.
